about: Health, assistance and schools family: links a law lacks by its own terms (scripts/law-wiring/matrix.ts reads every file here). Each why says what in the statute or the research makes it so.

web.why: the federal medical assistance percentage (42 U.S.C. 1396d(b)) fixes the federal government's share of each state's Medicaid spending for the people covered; by its terms it moves who pays, not who is covered or what care they get, which the expansion and the work requirement set (their links medicaid-expansion-to-coverage, medicaid-expansion-to-mortality, medicaid-expansion-to-medical-debt and work-requirement-to-coverage). The researched response to the subsidy is in the states' own spending, an elasticity of Medicaid spending per enrollee of -0.494 to -0.579 with respect to the after-subsidy price (Bundorf and Kessler 2021, NBER Working Paper 29492, abstract), a budget decision of the state's body, not a place outcome the web keeps. The dollars the match moves are on the journal (the money link).
